selection_method: Retain previous five candidates; add the three explicitly requested full-mode native-family positive fixtures at suffix4096 Requests10 seed42, suffix4096 Mpl86 seed43, and suffix2048 Sphinx70 seed43. Do not include call91 shortened prefix; 8192 TT probe is owned by parent.
comparison_partitioning: Separate serial process for each exact seed/suffix; compare-dir pairs are mode-specific served/full results for same fixture context.
admission_gate: Do not launch until parent/root explicitly admits, all TT queues terminal including call91 8192 probe, zero TT device owners, fresh MemAvailable >=100GB, and no HF/model process; then reverify all hashes.
execution_driver_behavior: Inert by default. --validate-only performs host-only source checks; --execute requires admitted status and successful P plus suffix8192 predecessor gates. --resume only accepts successful group-boundary checkpoints.
prelaunch_gates: P queue and completion terminal success with exit_code 0; exact P admission hash and immutable pins verified.
Suffix8192 queue plus served/full completions terminal success with exit_code 0; exact suffix8192 admission hash and immutable pins verified.
Before each group: zero device owners, no HF model process, MemAvailable >=100 GiB, all candidate/predecessor pins unchanged.
Groups run serially with recorded launch, completion, log, forecast, timeout, and progress hashes. STOP files pause only between groups; failed or interrupted groups are never retried automatically.
P and both suffix8192 mode elapsed_seconds values must lie inside their frozen forecast ranges or have exact root acceptance records before first HF launch; recheck before each group.
A completed HF group outside its forecast range pauses the serial queue until root accepts its exact completion hash and measured time; then --resume may continue.
forecast_miss_policy: No predecessor or per-group forecast miss is silently accepted.
